content.text: The Real Reason This Problem Exists

The primary barrier for South Asian creators is the lack of access to global payment systems. Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms do not support many local currencies, forcing creators to rely on less efficient methods or to forgo international sales entirely. This creates a gap where creators are unable to reach global markets, limiting their potential income and stifling innovation in digital products. The payment infrastructure is designed to favor certain regions, leaving many creators without viable options to monetize their work.
Why the Obvious Fixes Do Not Work

Many creators attempt to use workarounds like VPNs or alternative payment methods, but these solutions are often unreliable and do not address the underlying infrastructure issues. Platforms like Binance P2P offer some respite by supporting local currencies such as naira and cedis, but they still lack seamless integration for digital product sales. Moreover, payment solutions that rely on traditional banking systems are often bogged down by delays and high fees. As a result, these fixes fail to provide a sustainable, long-term solution for creators.
The Infrastructure That Solves It at the Base Layer

The COREMERCH solution leverages blockchain technology and decentralized infrastructure to eliminate geographic barriers entirely. By utilizing Cloudflare's robust framework combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can seamlessly receive payments in multiple cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee of under $0.10. This architecture ensures that creators maintain full ownership of their data and products, creating an environment of sovereignty and control typically absent in traditional platforms.
Decentralized payment solutions empower creators to sell globally.
How to Implement the Solution Today

Implementing this infrastructure is straightforward. First, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides all necessary blueprints and templates for setting up your digital commerce stack. Next, deploy the chosen stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing, and configure storage solutions like Supabase or Google Drive for file delivery. With these steps, you can create a fully operational online store within 48 hours.
What Your Store Looks Like After the Fix

Once implemented, your store will operate on a decentralized platform with instant payment confirmations and automated file delivery. You'll have a fully branded storefront that showcases your digital products, whether they are ebooks, courses, or software. With complete ownership and no recurring fees, you'll be free to scale your business as you see fit, without the constraints of traditional payment infrastructures.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Complete ownership means no subscription fees or platform dependence.

Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
